name: HTML 预览器
description: 打开 .html 文件时直接显示成网页：本地的 CSS、JS、图片、字体自动加载，脚本照常运行。可切换预览 / 分栏 / 源码，分栏时边写边刷新；桌面、平板、手机尺寸预览，内置控制台显示 console 输出和报错；引用的文件改动后自动刷新，可导出单文件 HTML。IDE 里的 AI 助手可以查看页面效果、读取控制台报错、在页面里运行脚本检查 DOM。

newFile.label: HTML 网页
newFile.template: Hello

agentTools.name: getConsole
agentTools.description: Messages the previewed page wrote to its console, uncaught script errors, and files that failed to load (with source locations). Edit the HTML / CSS / JS with your normal file tools — the preview refreshes by itself when files change.

limit.description: Most recent messages to return, default 100.

agentTools.name: reload
agentTools.description: Rebuild and reload the preview (re-reading every referenced file), wait until the page has loaded, and return the console output of the fresh load.

wait.description: Extra milliseconds to wait after the load event for late logs, default 500.

timeout.description: Max milliseconds to wait for the load event, default 8000.

agentTools.name: evaluate
agentTools.description: Run a JavaScript expression inside the previewed page (global scope) and return its result as text — e.g. document.querySelector('h1').textContent, getComputedStyle(el).color, or simulate a click to test interaction. Promises are awaited; elements are returned as outerHTML. Changes made this way only affect the preview, not the files.

agentTools.name: screenshot
agentTools.description: Optional device size to preview at (fill = fit the editor, desktop 1440×900, laptop 1280×800, tablet 820×1180, mobile 390×844; the choice is kept), landscape, mode (preview, split, source), and scrollY to scroll the page first.
